figure.caption:
Multidimensional mechanics of structural biological materials.
Normalized, permutated radar charts comparing four structural classes of natural materials (see Box 1). Legend (units): elastic and shear moduli, E and G (GPa); strain to failure, ε (%); tensile, compressive and flexural strength, σ_{T}, σ_{C} and σ_{F} (MPa); toughness, u_{T} (MJ·m^{-3}) or u_{T}* (kJ·m^{-2}); fracture toughness, K_{IC} (MPa·m^{1/2}); resilience, u_{R} (%); damping loss factor, tan δ (no units); hardness, H (MPa); impact strength, IS (kJ·m^{-2}). Notes: Data averages (lines) and standard deviations/errors/ranges (shaded regions) are listed in S1–S4 Tables, compiled from numerous sources (see Supporting Information); for reference, maximum values of each average property are displayed on the axes.
